t: Asakaa Music Genre History and Style Description | African Music Library
s: Asakaa, or Ghana Drill, is a regional music genre born in Kumasi, the capital city of Ghana’s Ashanti Region. It is a raw, melodic fusion of UK/US drill and Ghanaian street culture, blending Twi, English, and local slang over hard hitting beats.
